bmql.title: Performance Best Practice
bmql.text: Avoid executing BMQL inside loops. For large quotes, query once before loop iteration and cache results in a `dict("string")`.
bmql.linkText: Read Oracle CPQ Performance Best Practices

print.title: Production Advisory
print.text: Remove or comment out `print` statements before go-live to eliminate execution logging overhead during high-concurrency transactions.
print.linkText: Read Oracle CPQ Performance Best Practices

dict.title: Data Structure Performance
dict.text: Use `dict("string")` instead of `dict("string[]")` where possible; simpler single-dimensional dictionary structures process significantly faster on large quotes.
dict.linkText: Read Oracle CPQ Performance Best Practices

throwerror.title: Error Handling Best Practice
throwerror.text: Provide clear, actionable error messages specifying the exact missing field or step required so users can resolve the issue without contacting support.
throwerror.linkText: Read Oracle CPQ Error Messages Best Practices

urldata.title: Resilience & Security Best Practice
urldata.text: Always verify HTTP response status codes (`get(res, "status_code") == "200"`) and handle network timeouts gracefully.
urldata.linkText: Read Oracle CPQ Error Handling Best Practices

urldatabypost.title: Resilience & Security Best Practice
urldatabypost.text: Always verify HTTP response status codes (`get(res, "status_code") == "200"`) and use token-based authentication.
urldatabypost.linkText: Read Oracle CPQ Error Handling Best Practices

atoi.title: Safe Parsing Best Practice
atoi.text: Validate input strings with `isnumber()` before calling `atoi()` to prevent runtime exceptions on empty or non-numeric inputs.
atoi.linkText: Read Parsing Strings Into Numbers Best Practices

atof.title: Safe Parsing Best Practice
atof.text: Validate input strings with `isnumber()` before calling `atof()` to prevent runtime exceptions on non-numeric inputs.
atof.linkText: Read Parsing Strings Into Numbers Best Practices

split.title: Delimited Strings Best Practice
split.text: Avoid repeated unindexed string splitting inside line item loops; store pre-split lists in memory variables.
split.linkText: Read Storing Data in Delimited Strings Best Practices

join.title: String Construction Best Practice
join.text: Avoid nested delimiter joins in loops; consider `stringbuilder` or typed array manipulation.
join.linkText: Read Storing Data in Delimited Strings Best Practices
